full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of nervous tissue, specifically showing a cross-section of a peripheral nerve or ganglion. It displays large ganglion cells with prominent nuclei, some of which appear swollen or degenerated, surrounded by satellite cells and inflammatory infiltrates. The histological features are characteristic of a viral ganglionic infection, such as cytomegalovirus or another neurotropic virus affecting the nervous system.

random.description: This image is a high-magnification histopathology micrograph showing nervous tissue, likely a peripheral nerve ganglion, stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The field displays large ganglion cell bodies surrounded by satellite cells and inflammatory infiltrates. Eosinophilic structures and prominent nuclei are visible within the neuronal cell bodies. These histological findings are characteristic of a viral infection, such as rabies or herpes zoster, presenting with characteristic inclusion bodies or neuronal degeneration.
